title: JustinGuitar Lessons & Songs App Global Launch — Feature Highlights

locations.name: JustinGuitar studio
locations.basis: explicit mention in transcript: 'coming to you from my almost finished new studio'

summary: This 53-second YouTube Shorts promo presents the global launch of the JustinGuitar Lessons and Songs app. The speaker highlights key features—backing tracks that sound like the original recording, a new interface, and alignment of the beginner course with the site—along with a free tuner and a giveaway of 10 free subscriptions. Viewers are directed to a link in the description to enter, and feedback is invited, with a closing note encouraging use of the tuner regardless of subscription status.
topics: backing tracks sounding like the original recording
